```artifact
Feature: Account Transfer

  Scenario: Successful transfer between two distinct accounts
    Given account A has balance as specified
    And account B has balance as specified
    When a transfer of amount as specified is initiated from A to B
    Then the transfer succeeds
    And account A balance is reduced by amount as specified
    And account B balance is increased by amount as specified

  Scenario: Transfer fails due to insufficient funds
    Given account A has balance less than amount as specified
    And account B has balance as specified
    When a transfer of amount as specified is initiated from A to B
    Then the transfer fails with InsufficientFunds error
    And account A balance remains unchanged
    And account B balance remains unchanged

  Scenario: Transfer to same account is rejected
    Given account A has balance as specified
    When a transfer of amount as specified is initiated from A to A
    Then the transfer fails with InvalidTransfer error
    And account A balance remains unchanged

  Scenario Outline: Transfer with various conditions
    Given account <source> has balance <source_balance>
    And account <destination> has balance <destination_balance>
    When a transfer of amount <amount> is initiated from <source> to <destination>
    Then <result>
    And account <source> balance is <expected_source_balance>
    And account <destination> balance is <expected_destination_balance>
    Examples:
      | source | destination | source_balance | destination_balance | amount | result | expected_source_balance | expected_destination_balance |
      | A | B | as specified | as specified | as specified | succeeds | as specified minus amount | as specified plus amount |
      | A | A | as specified | as specified | as specified | fails with InvalidTransfer | as specified | as specified |
      | A | B | less than amount | as specified | as specified | fails with InsufficientFunds | as specified | as specified |
```
